paper_id: Liu et al. - 2005 - Efficient data retrieving in distributed data-streaming environments
title: Efficient Data Retrieving in Distributed Datastreaming Environments
motivation: 大规模分布式追踪系统中，查询流量大且分布不均，单点传输瓶颈明显
problem_framing: 将负载均衡问题形式化为在物理链路和组成员间同时平衡overlay multicast流量
key_insight: 多棵独立的多播树能利用更多物理链路，比单棵树更均匀地分散流量
method_signature: 分布式MMT协议，端主机自组织成多棵多播树，碎片合并迭代构建
evaluation_criteria: 物理流量/节点度偏差/链路应力分布/时延等多维指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: overlay multicast比IP multicast有更长延迟和更大流量开销
evidence_for_tour: existing approaches simply pay attention to the load balance among the group members
one multicast tree only use a small part of all the physical links
Our MMT has a little higher totally used physical link number
The performance penalty is longer end-to-end delay
the routing path ... may not match the optimal routing path at the IP layer
thinking_moves: 现有方法只关注overlay层负载，忽视物理链路层负载分布
从单树瓶颈反推多树分流的设计动机
借鉴分布式最小生成树算法实现碎片合并
用round-robin保证不同树有均衡机会选到优质链路
extraction_notes: 论文未明确标注会议名称或发表 venue，仅能从内容判断为网络/分布式系统领域学术工作
